description:
Kliczków Castle stands at the edge of the Lower Silesian Forests, near Osiecznica and about 15 km north-west of Bolesławiec. Its beginnings are traced to the end of the 13th century, when Duke Bolko I the Strict of the Świdnica-Jawór duchy established a border stronghold on the site. Over the following centuries the castle lost its original defensive character, passing through several noble families — among them the von Rechenberg and von Schellendorf families — who reshaped it into a residence rather than a fortress.

The buildings visitors see today, arranged around two courtyards, reflect this long residential rebuilding: a mix of neo-Renaissance and neo-Gothic work layered over the medieval core. The castle now operates as a hotel and spa, with around 88 rooms and apartments spanning Double or Twin Rooms, Studios, Superior and Premium Apartments, and Family Rooms — though an older listing gave a different breakdown, so this figure is best read as an approximate current count rather than a fixed total.

The parkland around the castle has been developed into a resort-style setting, with a Thalgo spa, an indoor pool, sauna and fitness room, tennis courts and a riding school, alongside a restaurant spread across three halls — amenities that make a stay here closer to a countryside resort than a quiet overnight in a historic building alone.

faqs.question: Is Kliczków Castle more of a resort than a historic hotel?
faqs.answer: It combines both — the buildings themselves date back to a long residential rebuilding of a 13th-century border stronghold, but the grounds now include a Thalgo spa, indoor pool, sauna, fitness room, tennis courts and a riding school, giving a stay here a resort character alongside the historic setting.

meta_description: Stay at Kliczków Castle in Lower Silesia, Poland — a 13th-century stronghold turned resort hotel with a spa, pool and riding school. From approx. €100/night.

hotel.how_to_stay:
**Getting there:** In Kliczków, about 15 km north-west of Bolesławiec in Lower Silesia, on the edge of a large forested area.

**Rooms & rates:** Rooms from approx. €100/night. Double rooms are compact (15 m²); the Standard Studio (30 m², with a private kitchenette and an inner-courtyard view) and the Family Room start around €123.

**On-site:** Thalgo spa, indoor pool, sauna and fitness room, plus tennis courts and a riding school in the parkland; the restaurant is spread over three halls, and breakfast is included in many rates.

**Good to know:** The complex is large and the facilities (pool, spa, tennis, riding) make it more of a resort stay than a quiet castle night. Check which building your room is in when you book.

**Combine with:** [Czocha Castle](/castles/poland/czocha-castle) and the Lower Silesian forests; the pottery town of Bolesławiec is the nearest town.
